findings.problem: Immediate navigation checks the previous cursor rather than the controlled chosen value. A cancelled pointer press can leave the cursor on C while A remains chosen. End, or Down at the last row, then consumes the key without emitting Chose(C). This violates the new Immediate contract and frozen on_key navigation assignment.
findings.reproduction: Public Harness: initial value A; mouse Down row C; mouse Up outside; assert cursor C/value A; End or Down; actual value A, expected C. Both independently executed tests fail.
findings.fix: Under Immediate, choose the navigation destination when it differs from the chosen value even if the cursor already identifies that destination. Preserve Deferred no-choice behavior and pointer cancellation. Add regression coverage for these mixed pointer/keyboard sequences and missing controlled values.
